text.p: Tropical Cyclone 08B is located near 14.2N/83.9E in the Bay of Bengal and has maximum sustained winds of 52 mph. This system is moving off to the northwest at 8 mph and isexpected to make landfall sometime on Sunday in central-eastern India. Heavy rain and gusty winds are expected to accompany this storm as it moves inland, leading to some flash flooding.

Tropical Cyclone Chantelle, packing winds of 35 mph, is located near 3.9S/73.8E and moving northwest at 9 mph. This system is expected to continue to decrease in intensity and dissipate within the next 12-24 hours.

Tropical Depression 40W has regenerated in the Pacific Ocean near 15.0N/134.2E and is moving west at 3 mph. This sysyem is expected to become nearly stationary and not strengthen over the next 24-36 hours.
